## 更新内容
- 调整展开候选栏工具栏为词频、单字与手写找字
- 优化五笔画栏为紧凑可折叠行并支持长按清空
- 修复点击笔画或单字时候选列表不刷新的问题
- 修复手写找字重新落笔未清空旧结果的问题

## Changes
- Replaced expanded candidates toolbar with Frequency, Single Char, and Handwriting
- Compacted five-stroke bar with collapsible row, undo, and long-press clear
- Fixed candidate paging refresh when toggling strokes or single character
- Fixed handwriting lookup stale results on new strokes
